_: V90Phase3Modulator's constructor and destructor, against t_v90p3mod.
The constructor has no branch of its own: every mutation below changes a
constant it hands to something else, or the ORDER of its two stores,
which is the only thing in it that is not a constant.  The destructor's
one claim is that its 22 bytes free the scrambler's history, so the
mutation for it is a destructor that keeps the buffer instead.

label: ctor: the session flag is stored after reset, not before
ctor: the V90Parameters * is not stored
ctor: the scrambler taps are the wrong way round
ctor: the near tap is 17, not 18
ctor: the far tap is 24, not 23
ctor: the scrambler history is one element short
ctor: the code companded is 0x41, not 0x40
ctor: the object starts in A-law
ctor: the object starts in SdNot, not Sd
ctor: the constructor warms up one symbol
ctor: the timeout base is 1, not 0
dtor: the scrambler's history is not freed
NOTE: generateSymbol and exitDIL
why: Two small members added to a file that already carries the two large ones they lead to.  generateSymbol is a single branch, so what can be mutated is the branch and the width of the field it tests; the test checks the dispatcher against the generator it should have chosen, on the BLOB's side alone, because a cross-side comparison of an inverted branch would agree with itself.  exitDIL is three guards and two arms, and its terminating arm is TEXTUALLY DISTINCT from the identical block inside generateV90Symbol -- different indentation and a different line split -- which is what keeps every anchor here matching once (finding 1264).  Nothing here mutates the message: the string is checked by the debug-site audit, not by this set.
